notes: Own gravimetric H2 isotherms (Hiden XEMIS) at -196 C up to 100 bar on CO2-activated biomass carbons (C 95-98 wt%); BET surface areas and H2 uptakes are tabulated for the same activated samples (Tables 2 and 3). The paper says the uptake data are reported as total adsorption (Section 2.3), which does not affect eligibility. The TPSA working capacities and the -116 C uptakes are predicted from Toth fits, not measured, but the 77 K measured values suffice. Section 3.3 compares the best sample with the authors' earlier microsphere carbon [31] but does not state that every value was published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. record.json is_retracted is false and neither the main text nor the SI mentions a retraction. Not a review, thesis, patent or abstract-only item.
